Monday to Friday a 06:20–14:20 opens the office and a 07:00–15:30 joins at 08:00, on the floor until then; a 13:30–22:00 and a 14:00–22:30 take over, the 13:30 back on the floor from 19:30. Saturday two 06:20–14:30s, one on the floor until 08:00, then a 13:30–21:30, on the floor from 19:30, and a 14:00–22:30 until 22:00. Not identical pairs: a rule waived for this design. The “of whom” rows take these people out of each side, so the floor rows compare like with like.
